  • Method Details

    • fieldsOf

      public static List<Field> fieldsOf(Class<?> type)
      Returns every declared field from type up to (but excluding) Object, base class first.

      Base-first ordering means settings inherited from a shared module base appear above the subclass's own settings in the GUI, which is what users expect. Within one class the JVM reports fields in declaration order.
